text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a tragedy! Failing to seize victory,
only to come tumbling down Nakayama's hill!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dethroned before even taking the throne...
Truly a Rolling Supreme Overlord...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But there's no need to worry,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A stumble along the way only adds flavor to the story!
This result isn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't that discouraged. Well, she did make
the board, so it certainly wasn't a bad start.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
Is this really... all my running amounts to?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I should have been able to get a better time than that...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Ayabe-san.
It seems you aren't quite satisfied either.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet there are no regrets.
Our duet made the Satsuki Sho
an absolute sensation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My rhythm... was thrown off...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ho... Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because you were there, my pace was thrown off.
Though getting dragged along was due to my own weakness...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still... without you...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems you've harbored resentment towards me.
That's what makes you a true rival. But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Was the fact that you felt off really my fault?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If hating me improves your running,
I don't mind in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do you even understand about me...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I understand, everything.
You are an Umamusume, and you wanted to win the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And the reason I couldn't focus today
lies within myself."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Face the agony of creation.
Just as I always face the mirror.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What's with... that person...?
Could they have... seen through me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That can't be.
And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Facing... myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that night—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: O stars above, laugh at me for failing to secure the win.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, just as you guessed, we were able to win!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I shine too brightly right from the start of the Triple Crown races,
the other Umamusume will just fade into the background too much...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems the throne of the 'End-of-Century Overlord' is still far off.
So long as even a faint trace of mercy lingers in this heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O indulged in a one-person drama.
Even defeat made for fine dramatic material, it seemed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun,
let us decide our next objective.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Where is the new theater upon which I am destined to dance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The answer is—obvious. Once the first jewel
of the Triple Crown path is won, the only way forward is to the second.
choice_data_list: To Tokyo Racecourse, for the Japanese Derby

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected. Very well.
The supreme race shining brilliantly in the Classic sky.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san will likely... no, definitely enter the race and add brilliance to it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look up at the night sky... Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That star—is the star of the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The North Star shone overhead.
However... T.M. Opera O
arbitrarily renamed it."
